p1: This happy song does not say who wrote it. It calls the whole world to shout and sing for joy.
Then the singer called, “Come and hear! I will tell what the Lord has done for me.”
He told how he prayed out loud. Then he said, “Heavenly Father has heard my prayer!”
p2: In another song, Asaph sang, “We will not hide these stories from the children.” Families told their children the wonderful things the Lord had done. That way the children would trust Him too.
Your family has stories of how Heavenly Father helped them. Tonight, ask a grown-up to tell you one. Someday you can say, “Come and hear!” too.
old: When something wonderful happens, we can hardly wait to tell everybody about it! One of the Psalms is exactly like that.
“Come and hear!” the person sang out. “Let me tell you all the wonderful things Heavenly Father has done!”
He was so thankful and excited that he wanted to share Heavenly Father’s goodness with every single person he could find.
When Heavenly Father does good things for us, we can share the happy news too — with our family, our friends, and everyone we love. Telling about Heavenly Father’s goodness makes our joy grow bigger.
